To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel molecule designed on the basis of multitarget drug design strategy, able to interact with epidermal growth receptor and to trigger apoptotic cell death, has been synthesized.
we have developed and synthesized a new class of compounds that can simultaneously block the epidermal growth receptor and trigger apoptosis in human cancer cell lines.
we have designed and synthesized a novel multitargeted drug able to irreversibily block EGFR and to induce apoptosis.

the design, synthesis, and evaluation of novel multitarget-directed compounds, which can exert antiproliferative and proapoptotic activities by blocking EGFR and by inducing apoptosis in tumor cells.
the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of a novel class of multitarget-directed drugs.

the present work provides evidence of a new class of multitarget compounds, able to block EGFR and to induce tumor cell apoptosis.
the novel compounds, in particular 4a, 4b and 6, are endowed with a multifunctional profile that makes them suitable candidates for further preclinical and clinical investigations.
our results provide the basis for the development of novel anticancer drugs endowed with the ability of simultaneously blocking EGFR and inducing apoptosis.
